The work, from RJM’s own photo album.

Most of the work is bespoke, from cutting a lawn and clearing a garden to designing a new garden from scratch. Here it is by kind of job.

Patios and paths

Patios laid or cleaned, with paths to go with them.

Paths can be made of slabs, gravel, block pavers, concrete or a combination of any. They can be formal and straight, or stepping stones that wander to anywhere in your garden.

  • Patios: laid or cleaned
  • Paths
  • Powerwashing

Lawns and turf

A lawn can be created using turf or grown from seed. That may depend on the size of the area, the quality of the ground or the cost. Turf and seed also come in different qualities and durability depending on what you want to use your lawn for.

Artificial grass is also on the list, and lawns can be repaired where it is practical to do so: scarifying and reseeding.

  • Turfing
  • Artificial grass
  • Scarifying and reseeding

Fencing and gates

Fences can be a few feet long and quite low, to a fence that surrounds your entire garden if that is what you want. It can be a picket type, sectional, or continuous wood, or a mixture of wood and concrete and even include some trellis.

  • Fencing
  • Gates

Pergolas and decking

Pergolas can range from a few pieces of wood to something made purely to fit in with your garden. One can cover a slabbed or gravelled area with a table and chairs, or just be a feature for your plants to climb on.

Decking is built or cleaned.

  • Pergolas
  • Decking: built or cleaned

Walling, ponds and water features

Walling can be made from stone, bricks, concrete or wooden sleepers. Where the wall is, and whether it is a retaining wall, decides how and what it is best made of. Ray helps you choose.

Ponds are limited only by imagination: formal with basic shapes, or made to look as natural as possible. Water features add something to look at, and the noise of running water.

  • Walling
  • Ponds
  • Water features

Landscape gardening is our passion.

Every garden is unique and personal, so we work with you to create your perfect place within the natural environment.

Whether you want a full and elaborate paradise or a cherished low-maintenance area to feel good in, we are happy to chat and advise. A garden design is a big task that will last a very long time, so Ray works with you each step of the way.
